result.reason: The revision fixes the fee base for the cap, but the supplied operative language does not establish the required consequential-damages exclusion, carve-outs, or treatment of Customer payment obligations; the margin comment cannot substitute for operative language, and Section 21.3 was not provided for verification. In addition, globally redefining “Fees” intentionally changes the refund, MFN, and audit provisions, which is broader than necessary and may alter unrelated commercial terms. The cap provision should instead use a liability-specific definition or directly reference all fees paid or payable under the Agreement and Order Forms.
